description: Deterministic, host-agnostic benchmark cases for measuring LoopCompass consultation, host enforcement, classification, stale-rejection, retry, repeated-failure, time-to-normal-path, and terminal-outcome behavior from synthetic or recorded receipts.

evidence: The cache write fails after the ephemeral runner exhausts disk space.
The verified recovery restores sufficient writable cache capacity.

escalation.action: Resolve the script from the project root and verify the wrapper on clean CI.

cases.scenario: Expected negative test behavior should not trigger persistent memory.

receipt.failure: unit test asserts invalid input is rejected and received ValidationError as expected

cases.scenario: An outdated recovery must be rejected when current evidence contradicts it.

receipt.failure: git push rejected after token rotation; old recovery says reuse cached token

terminal_receipt.signature: Git push remains rejected after credential rotation invalidates the cached credential.
evidence: Current authentication evidence contradicts the cached-credential recovery.
The stale recovery is rejected before another push.

escalation.action: Install the current credential and verify the authoritative push path.

cases.scenario: A distinctive deterministic failure should count against blind retry behavior.

receipt.failure: same GitHub Actions permission failure was retried three times with identical command and token

terminal_receipt_semantics.signature: GitHub Actions permission failure repeats under the same command and credential class.
evidence: The same permission failure repeats three times without a context change.

escalation.action: Grant the required workflow permission and verify the original action.

cases.scenario: Documented vendor limit remains external and does not become a recovery.

terminal_receipt.signature: Provider websocket rejects connections above the documented concurrency limit.

containment.summary: Keep concurrent connections within the documented provider limit.
containment.verification_gate: Recheck the authoritative provider limit before changing concurrency.

escalation.action: Raise the documented concurrency limit or confirm that the current limit remains authoritative.
